name: Synthesia Sessions
desc: Platform for two-way conversations with interactive avatars
desc_zh: 与交互式数字人双向对话的平台
solves: An avatar could only play back a script; Sessions answers back, so practice and interviews scale past one recording.
solves_zh: 数字人以前只能按脚本播放；Sessions 会回应，练习和访谈因此能超出一次录制的规模。
best_for: Two hundred new hires need a difficult-conversation rehearsal this week; put them in a Session instead of booking rooms.
best_for_zh: 两百名新员工这周要练一次困难对话；让他们进 Session，不用去订会议室。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.synthesia.io/blog (post "Sessions is a New Platform Where Intera）。 Announced as the umbrella for interactive-avatar formats; Roleplay Sessions (2026-07-22) is the first release under it and is recorded separately.
